seo.description: Plan Amezrou in Zagora: historic earthen lanes, old Jewish quarter heritage, traditional architecture, oasis walks and local artisan crafts.

name: Amezrou
hero_subtitle: Earthen lanes and the old Jewish quarter — a walkable heritage corner of the Zagora oasis.

info.entry_val: Free to walk; tips for guides

overview.title: Lanes of earth and memory
overview.p1: Amezrou is the historic oasis village side of Zagora: narrow lanes, earthen walls and traces of the old Jewish quarter that once formed an integral part of the town’s social and craft fabric.
overview.p2: It is best discovered on foot. A short walk gives insight into traditional Draa Valley architecture and daily life away from the main road strip.
overview.p3: Stay respectful in residential alleys and ask for permission before photographing locals or private doorways.

gallery.subtitle: Glimpses of architecture and village life.

1.title: Access
1.desc: Easily reached on foot or by a short bicycle ride from central Zagora.

2.title: Sun Protection
2.desc: Bring water, a hat, and sunscreen, especially when walking in warmer months.

3.title: Respect
3.desc: Respect local residents' privacy in narrow alleys and residential quarters.

q1.question: How far from the centre?
q1.answer: It's located right on the edge of town, just a short walk or taxi ride from central Zagora.

q2.question: Is a guide needed?
q2.answer: Not strictly required, but a local guide adds great value regarding the history of the old Jewish quarter and artisan traditions.
